key.name: limits-interval
key.description: How often to check the agents' rate limits in the background, which keeps the percentage in the top bar current. Opening the panel always checks right away. Anthropic refuses checks that come too often; the collector then pauses for 1 to 15 minutes.

key.name: scan-interval
key.summary: Minutes between full rescans of local usage
key.description: How often to reread transcripts and OpenCode history for the token charts.

key.name: session-threshold
key.summary: Show the session limit in the top bar from this percentage
key.description: Once the 5-hour session limit is at least this full, the top bar shows it, even when the weekly limit is fuller. Below it, the top bar shows the fullest limit. 0 always shows the session limit.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: Asks the git repository this was installed from for its newest release tag, every hour and after waking from sleep.

key.name: agent
key.description: An agent to run in the terminal, or a desktop app ("opencode-desktop", "claude-desktop").

key.name: agent-command
key.description: Used when agent is "custom", for example "claude --continue".

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Terminal to open the agent in
key.description: "auto" uses the desktop's default terminal. Signing in and updating use it too, also when the agent is a desktop app.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Used when terminal is "custom". {command} is replaced by the agent's command; without it, the agent goes at the end. Example: "ghostty --window-decoration=false -e {command}".
